shortDescription: Patriot Mobile disclosed a 21% increase in first-half revenue in its paperwork for a US initial public offering on Friday.

children: Patriot Mobile disclosed a 21% increase in first-half revenue in its paperwork for a US initial public offering on Friday.
Revenue rose to $53.4 million in the six months ended June 30, from $44 million a year earlier. Net loss widened to $4.6 million from $1.8 million during the period
Patriot Mobile is a Christian-conservative mobile virtual network operator based in Texas
The company was a major sponsor of the 2026 Republican National Committee Midterm Convention in Dallas, where Vice President JD Vance and other administration officials spoke
Founded in 2013 as a niche cellular reseller, Patriot Mobile officially dropped its traditional startup imagery in 2016 and rebranded aggressively to lean into conservative activism
The company plans to use the proceeds from the offering to repay debt and for general corporate purposes, including working capital, expansion and potential acquisitions
It plans to list its shares on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "PTRT". Northland Securities is the sole book-running manager of the offering
